subject: maths
question: If 15 boys can build a house in 20 days, in how many days can 20 boys complete the same work.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

According to the chain rule, M₁ × D₁ = M₂ × D₂

15 × 20 = 20 × D₂

D₂ = 15

**∴ The correct answer is 15 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial number of boys (M₁) = 15

Initial days required (D₁) = 20

New number of boys (M₂) = 20

**Formula Used:**

M₁ × D₁ = M₂ × D₂

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total work = M₁ × D₁

⇒ Total work = 15 × 20 = 300 boy-days

⇒ Now, the same work is done by 20 boys in D₂ days.

⇒ 300 = 20 × D₂

⇒ D₂ = 300 ÷ 20

⇒ D₂ = 15

**∴ The correct answer is 15 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Chain Rule (MDH Concept)

If M₁ persons can do W₁ work in D₁ days working H₁ hours, and M₂ persons do W₂ work in D₂ days working H₂ hours, then (M₁ × D₁ × H₁) ÷ W₁ = (M₂ × D₂ × H₂) ÷ W₂.

Total Work Concept

Total work is considered constant. It is typically the product of the number of workers and the time taken to complete the job.

Work and Efficiency

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken. If the number of workers increases, the time required to complete the same work decreases proportionally.
